interpretation.result: Later public GBIF clusters are not generally concentrated within 2-5 km of pre-2021 clusters in this strict 13-species Japan benchmark.
interpretation.primary_reason_to_investigate: The later public record set includes geographically detached observation components and the strict <=1 km declared-uncertainty filter leaves limited temporal evaluability.
interpretation.architectural_consequence: Do not use nearest-known local continuation as the universal outer search rule. Preserve LOCAL_CONTINUATION as a typed mode and keep DETACHED_COMPONENT/SENTINEL broad search as separate upstream regimes.
interpretation.does_not_show: This does not show that occurrence-conditioned environmental support fails within a declared regional frame, and it does not invalidate the independently confirmed 10-km Japan robust candidate-patch core.
